subject: Appalachian Mountains
hook: APPALACHIAN MOUNTAINS IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The Appalachian Mountains are not confined to North America; geologically, they are parts of the exact same mountain chain as the Scottish Highlands and Morocco's Atlas Mountains, separated when continental drift tore apart the Central Pangean Mountains.
angle_support: It is geologically related to the Scottish Highlands, Atlas Mountains, Scandinavian Mountains, and Ouachitas, as these ranges all originally belonged to the sprawling Central Pangean Mountains before plate tectonics tore them apart.

The modern Appalachians and their relatives themselves were created by a series of three distinct orogenies beginning approximately 480 million years ago, making them one of the oldest surviving mountain ranges in the world.
title: The Hidden Truth About The Appalachian Mountains
description: The Appalachian Mountains are not just a North American feature. They are part of a global chain that includes mountains in Scotland and Morocco, separated by the breakup of the supercontinent Pangea.
narration: APPALACHIAN MOUNTAINS IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture an isolated North American range. It was closer to a massive, singular supercontinent formation that once spanned across the Atlantic Ocean to distant foreign lands. These peaks are the exact same geologic remnants as Scotland’s Highlands and Morocco’s Atlas Mountains. They were all connected as the Central Pangean Mountains before continental drift tore the supercontinent apart four hundred million years ago. The ocean didn't create these mountains; it just hid their siblings.
